name: anakin
description: Anakin web data platform (remote MCP server, tools-only). Scrape pages to markdown, map and crawl sites, run AI search and deep research, execute pre-built Wire actions across hundreds of popular websites, monitor pages for changes, compare AI answer engines, and drive a real cloud browser with natural language.

interface.longDescription: Turn any website into clean markdown or structured JSON. Run AI search and multi-source deep research, execute pre-built Wire actions across hundreds of popular sites, watch pages for changes on a schedule, and drive a real cloud browser from natural language.
defaultPrompt: Scrape this URL and give me the key details as JSON.
Search for the latest EU AI Act compliance deadlines and summarize the key dates.
Use a Wire action to get the top products in Walmart's electronics category and list their prices.
